## 新增

- **接入 OpenAI 与 Google Gemini** — 设置 → 接口新增 **OpenAI**（`gpt-realtime-translate`，输出 13 种语言）和 **Gemini Live Translate**（`gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview`，54 种语言，全部可朗读），与阿里云百炼的 Qwen3.5 / 3、Qwen3.8 并列可选。感谢 @zixiaoluobai 的建议（#3）。
- **自定义模型和接入地址** — 模型可从预设里选，也可以填任意模型 ID；「高级」里可填自定义地址，代理或兼容同一接口的服务都能接。切换接口时，每个接口记住自己的模型、每家记住自己的地址。
- **各家的 API Key 分开保存** — 都存在系统凭据库里，两个 Qwen 接口共用百炼的 Key。
- **关于页显示更新内容** — 检查更新后直接看到新版本（或当前版本）的新增与修复，按界面语言显示。
- **音色带介绍** — 47 种音色都有中文名和一句简介，可以按名字或描述搜索。

## 改进

- 设置页重新整理：分「连接 / 翻译 / 高级」三组，每项一行；接口、模型、地域都改为下拉框；外观和界面语言只保留在标题栏。
- 标题栏 logo 下方显示当前模型，点它直接打开设置。
- 百炼的 API Key、可用模型、业务空间管理三个链接按当前地域跳到对应控制台；业务空间 ID 的提示按地域区分（北京 `llm-`、新加坡 `ws-`）。
- 关闭字幕窗时自动收起下面的样式控件；音色下拉框加宽；灰色提示不再有多余空隙。
- OpenAI / Gemini 下朗读时提示「该接口的音色由服务端决定」。

## 修复

- 服务端拒绝会话时（例如所选地域没有该模型）直接显示错误并结束，不再一声不响地挂到超时。
- 模型字段缺失时按接口取各自的默认模型，不再错把 Qwen 的模型名发给其他接口。

## 功能一览

- 三种音频来源：麦克风 / 系统声音 / 本地音频文件
- 四种接口：阿里云百炼 Qwen3.5 / 3、Qwen3.8，OpenAI，Google Gemini；模型和接入地址可自定义
- 最多 60 种语言互译，源语言可自动检测
- 朗读译文：Qwen 有 47 种音色、29 种目标语言有语音输出；OpenAI / Gemini 所有目标语言都能朗读
- 独立字幕窗：置顶、双语 / 仅译文 / 仅原文、字号颜色描边对齐可调、锁定后点击穿透、右键菜单直接改
- 系统托盘、翻译历史、导出 TXT / SRT、界面中英文与浅色 / 深色主题、启动自动检查更新

## 安装与打开

需要一个 API Key：[阿里云百炼](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/model/settings/api-key)、[OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) 或 [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) 任选其一。首次打开后点右上角齿轮，选好接口再填入 Key。

### Windows 10 / 11

1. 下载 `ReaLingo_0.6.0_x64-setup.exe`（推荐）或 `ReaLingo_0.6.0_x64_en-US.msi`，双击安装。
2. 安装包没有代码签名，SmartScreen 可能提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：点 **更多信息 → 仍要运行**。
3. 从开始菜单打开 ReaLingo。Windows 11 会把托盘图标折叠进 `^`，想常驻就拖到任务栏上。

### macOS 12+（Intel 与 Apple Silicon 通用）

1. 下载 `ReaLingo_0.6.0_universal.dmg`，打开后把 ReaLingo 拖进「应用程序」。
2. 应用没有经过 Apple 公证，首次打开会被拦下（提示「已损坏」或「无法验证开发者」）。在终端执行一次：
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ReaLingo.app
   ```
   或者先打开一次，再到 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性**，在页面下方点 **仍要打开**。
3. 首次用麦克风 / 系统声音时会弹权限申请，点允许。系统声音需要 **macOS 14.4+**。
4. 从旧版本升级后如果系统声音没有反应，到 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 屏幕与系统录音**（以及 **麦克风**）里把 ReaLingo 删掉，重新打开应用再授权一次。

### Linux（Ubuntu 22.04+）

1. 下载 `ReaLingo_0.6.0_amd64.deb`，用 apt 安装（会自动拉依赖，`dpkg -i` 不会）：
   ```bash
   sudo apt install ./ReaLingo_0.6.0_amd64.deb
   ```
2. 从应用菜单打开 ReaLingo，或在终端运行 `realingo`。
3. 系统声音需要 PulseAudio 或 PipeWire（Ubuntu 桌面默认就有）。托盘图标不响应左键，用右键菜单里的「显示主窗口」。

## New

- **OpenAI and Google Gemini** — Settings → API now offers **OpenAI** (`gpt-realtime-translate`, 13 output languages) and **Gemini Live Translate** (`gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview`, 54 languages, all spoken) alongside Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's Qwen3.5 / 3 and Qwen3.8. Thanks to @zixiaoluobai for the suggestion (#3).
- **Custom model and endpoint** — pick a preset or type any model ID; under Advanced, a custom URL lets you use a proxy or any service speaking the same API. Switching APIs remembers each one's model and each vendor's URL.
- **A separate API key per vendor** — all kept in the OS credential store; both Qwen APIs share the Model Studio key.
- **What's new in About** — after an update check, the new (or current) version's features and fixes show right there, in the interface language.
- **Voice descriptions** — all 47 voices have a name and a one-line description, searchable by either.

## Improvements

- Settings reorganised into Connection / Translation / Advanced, one row per setting; API, model and region are dropdowns; theme and interface language stay in the title bar only.
- The current model shows under the title-bar logo; click it to open Settings.
- The Model Studio links (API key, available models, workspace management) follow the selected region; the workspace ID hint matches it (`llm-` for Beijing, `ws-` for Singapore).
- Turning the subtitle overlay off folds its style controls away; the voice picker is wider; grey hints no longer float in extra space.
- Reading aloud with OpenAI / Gemini notes that the service picks the voice.

## Fixes

- When the server refuses a session (e.g. the model is not offered in that region), the error shows and the session ends, instead of hanging silently until a timeout.
- A missing model field now falls back to each API's own default, instead of sending a Qwen model name to another API.

## Features

- Three audio sources: microphone / system audio / a local audio file
- Four APIs: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Qwen3.5 / 3 and Qwen3.8, OpenAI, Google Gemini; model and endpoint are customisable
- Up to 60 languages, with automatic source detection
- Read the translation aloud: Qwen offers 47 voices and speaks 29 target languages; OpenAI / Gemini speak every target language they offer
- Standalone subtitle overlay: always on top, bilingual / translation only / source only, adjustable size, colours, outline and alignment, click-through when locked, a right-click menu for quick changes
- System tray, translation history, TXT / SRT export, Chinese / English interface, light / dark themes, update check at startup

## Install

You need an API key from [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/ap-southeast-1/model/settings/api-key), [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) or [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). On first launch, click the gear in the top-right, pick the API and paste the key.

### Windows 10 / 11

1. Download `ReaLingo_0.6.0_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `ReaLingo_0.6.0_x64_en-US.msi` and run it.
2. The installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. Open ReaLingo from the Start menu. Windows 11 folds new tray icons under `^`; drag it onto the taskbar to keep it visible.

### macOS 12+ (universal: Intel and Apple Silicon)

1. Download `ReaLingo_0.6.0_universal.dmg`, open it and drag ReaLingo into Applications.
2. The app is not notarised, so the first launch is blocked ("damaged" or "unidentified developer"). Run once in Terminal:
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ReaLingo.app
   ```
   or open it once, then click **Open Anyway** at the bottom of **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
3. Allow the microphone / system audio permission when asked. System audio needs **macOS 14.4+**.
4. If system audio stays silent after upgrading, remove ReaLingo under **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording** (and **Microphone**), then reopen the app and grant it again.

### Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+)

1. Download `ReaLingo_0.6.0_amd64.deb` and install it with apt (which pulls in dependencies; `dpkg -i` does not):
   ```bash
   sudo apt install ./ReaLingo_0.6.0_amd64.deb
   ```
2. Open ReaLingo from the app menu, or run `realingo` in a terminal.
3. System audio needs PulseAudio or PipeWire (standard on the Ubuntu desktop). The tray icon ignores left clicks; use "Show main window" in its right-click menu.
